messages:
Jordan: Drafting a tiny set of hiring-focused OKR and self-review micro-templates for talent partners and hiring managers. Goal is to make hiring work measurable and easy to paste into reviews and calibration notes. Quick review?

Lee: Love it. Can we include one that captures candidate experience improvements (not just velocity)?

Jordan: Yep — added CX line and a DEI signal one. Keeping each template to 1-2 headline lines + a 1-sentence context cue.

Camille: Could we add an "offer quality" success metric (e.g., offer acceptance rate by cohort)? That helps tie to retention/hire-fit.

Jordan: Added. Also included a manager coaching snippet for writing the hiring bit into manager self-reviews.

Aisha: Tiny wording suggestion: use "time-to-offer" rather than "cycle time" for clarity with recruiting dashboards.

people-ops-bot: Saved template to /templates/hiring/hiring-okr-selfreview-microtiles  public

Jordan: Pasteable hiring OKR micro-templates (pick one):
- Velocity-focused OKR headline: "Reduce time-to-offer for IC-engineer roles from 18d to 12d"
  - Context cue: "Shorter offers will improve candidate experience and reduce pipeline leakage; we'll target faster panel scheduling and clearer hiring criteria."
  - Success signals (1 line): "Median time-to-offer <=12d and interview-to-offer conversion +10% for the cohort."

- Candidate experience headline: "Improve candidate NPS for final-stage interviews from 6.8 to 8.2"
  - Context cue: "Better prep + clearer timelines should raise candidate sentiment and referral likelihood."
  - Success signals: "Candidate NPS survey >=8.0 and positive qualitative notes in 80% of closed-loop feedback."

- Diversity-aware hiring headline: "Increase underrepresented offers to 30% of hires for XYZ roles"
  - Context cue: "Work with sourcers and hiring managers to expand pipeline and adjust scorecards; track drop-off by cohort."
  - Success signals: "Offer acceptance and performance signals comparable to baseline; no increase in time-to-hire >2 days."

- Offer-quality headline: "Raise offer acceptance rate from 72% to 82% for enterprise sales hires"
  - Context cue: "Tighter manager alignment on comp banding and candidate motivations; refine interview-to-offer playbook."
  - Success signals: "Acceptance rate >=82% and first-90-day retention >=90%."

Manager self-review snippets (1-2 lines):
- "Partnered with recruiting to cut time-to-offer from 18d to 12d by instituting weekly slotted interview blocks and a hiring rubric; this increased offer conversion by 10%."
- "Led candidate experience improvements: added clearer scheduling cadences and interviewer prep; candidate NPS rose to 8.0."

Hiring partner self-review snippets (1 line):
- "Optimized top-of-funnel and reduced pipeline leakage, contributing to a 10% lift in panel-to-offer conversion for Q."

Calibration note (single line):
- "Hiring metric is operationally measurable via ATS dashboards; flag any data parity concerns during calibration."

Jordan: Quick pasteable manager coaching prompts for 1:1s:
- "What hiring constraints do you see that block hitting the 12d target?"
- "Which roles need priority slotted interviews this quarter?"
- "Who on the interview panel needs a rubric refresh to speed decisions?"

Camille: This is super useful. Can you add a 1-line link to the ATS dashboard id? If not public, maybe a note to attach the query in the review.

Jordan: Good call 97 added a short reminder: 'Attach ATS query id or a snapshot of cohort metrics to the review.'

Aisha: :white_check_mark: I'll pilot these with two hiring managers this cycle and report back at calibration.

people-ops-bot: Broadcast scheduled for Monday 9:30am PT to hiring-managers channel.
